'''Ironstar''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Ironstar was present in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] where he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWG:Ns" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelPilotTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Commander Ironstar]]
Ironstar appeared aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ns" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Commander Ironstar was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Commander Ironstar was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Rebel starfighters in the Naboo system.<ref name="SWG:Ns" />
